name: Spiky Pit (3-4)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Quest #10: The Broken Scales

disable: DC 12 Thievery check to remove the trapdoor
reset: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

items.name: Pitfall
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks onto the trapdoor

---

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes 10 bludgeoning damage plus 3d8 piercing damage from sharp implements at the bottom of the pit. That creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling.

text: A wooden trapdoor covers a pit that's 10 feet square and 20 feet deep.
